name: Loaves
overview: The topic of Loaves, particularly highlighted in the miracle of the five loaves and two fishes, demonstrates Jesus' divine provision and authority over physical needs. In Matthew 14:15-20, Jesus instructs His disciples to feed the multitude despite their limited resources, takes the five loaves and two fishes, blesses them, breaks them, and distributes them so that all are satisfied with leftovers remaining. This event powerfully reveals Christ’s compassion and power to multiply scarce resources to meet the needs of many.
